text: Implemented the paired migration in the reserved slice. PLSC, CCA, and RRR now construct typed tables and row relations, derive marginals/cross operators through secondOrder, solve one generalized cross-SVD, build FunctionalFrames plus OperatorProgramFit, and expose a typed directed RRR coefficient. PairedGmd and PairedGmdMetric are removed. Added partial-alignment dense oracle, generalized residual/normalization certificates, row permutation, scale/sign, subspace-semantics, coefficient-orientation, storage-policy, unchanged R-parity, and IR coefficient-role tests. Focused JVM/JS paired suites and full multivar+IR JVM/JS suites pass; compileAll passes.
